decisive_items: Mild cerebral atrophy/aging more pronounced in the curvatures of the cerebral hemispheres
Few, micro-ischemic focal lesions in the periventricular and deep white matter of the cerebral hemispheres
response.rationale: The MRI findings of micro-ischemic periventricular and deep white matter lesions are characteristic of cerebral small vessel disease. Vascular dementia is less certain because the cognitive impairment is only mild and improved after treatment; depression and anxiety are described as comorbid, and NPH lacks ventriculomegaly or a supportive clinical triad.

rejected.why: Depression and anxiety are reported as comorbid symptoms and do not account for the asymmetric left-sided motor difficulties or ischemic imaging changes.
Partially empty sella turcica is nonspecific and there is no ventriculomegaly or classic triad for normal pressure hydrocephalus.
Anxiety alone is only mentioned as a comorbid symptom and does not explain the focal left-sided findings or white matter ischemic lesions.
